content: Next, all the $Q$-functions are jointly trained using the DQN algorithm with $\epsilon $-greedy exploration BIBREF15, BIBREF16. At evaluation time, the argmax of each $Q$-function is concatenated to produce $a_t$. Importantly, in $V_{\text{type}}$ a special token $<$s$>$ is used to denote the absence of a word, so the model can produce actions with different lengths. Figure FIGREF57 in Appendix SECREF55 shows a depiction of this model.
